dogecoin.text:
How could SNL flip the script on the world tonight with special guest @elonmusk?

1) Elon announces he is Satoshi Nakamoto - The anonymous creator of @Bitcoin 

2) Elon reveals he is “Big Doge” and hits the sell button on all his @dogecoin while live on the air.

@EdKrassen Not sure how it could be “terrible”. Meme coins are notoriously risky gambles; a Trump coin is no safer than a Doge coin. 

I just don’t understand why introduce a meme coin the week before inauguration. I honestly thought it was a hack at first. Confusing move for sure…
@dogecoin_empire Well obviously… you’re not gonna slay a dragon with a vacuum.
